subject.title: fix(macos): keep Canvas hidden for agent content operations

question: Should hidden `canvas.snapshot` calls intentionally return `CANVAS_HIDDEN` instead of preserving the prior implicit presentation behavior?
rationale: The choice changes an established agent-visible command outcome and determines whether avoiding focus theft takes precedence over snapshot compatibility.

options.title: Adopt explicit hidden error
options.body: Accept `CANVAS_HIDDEN` as the documented contract after real macOS proof confirms hidden updates and reconnect behavior.

options.title: Preserve snapshot presentation
options.body: Limit non-presenting behavior to eval and A2UI operations while retaining the existing snapshot side effect.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit hidden error
recommendation.body: Accept `CANVAS_HIDDEN` as the documented contract after real macOS proof confirms hidden updates and reconnect behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence connects this person most directly to the macOS Canvas contract and current implementation.
